includes: Additive private SQLite directory and read-only source capability in codex-utils-path.
No new dependency or Cargo/MODULE lock change.
Nine new Windows-only native tests; previous private-state tests unchanged.
excludes: No state SQLite recovery or cognitive memory wiring.
No fallback that opens a source filename through SQLite.
No claim that historical native results validate these new bytes.
No coherent-cut, currentness, writer-authority, or whole Windows recovery qualification claim.

files.change: Export the additive sqlite submodule under the existing cfg(windows) private_state module.

Add FILE_OPEN RetainRead, true FILE_CREATE CreateNew, explicit directory FILE_TRAVERSE, and handle-based local-disk verification. Existing three access modes retain their desired-access/disposition/sharing results.

Retain strict PrivateState owner/ACL policy; add purpose-specific SQLite policies and owner/group/control/full-DACL snapshots. Directory creation descriptor has one protected current-owner full-access OI/CI ACE.
Capture validated file/volume identity, content metadata, and security snapshots via the documented typed Windows APIs.
PrivateSqliteDirectory create/open/create-new-file/flush; RetainedSqliteDirectory open/retain/verify; RetainedSqliteFile bounded read and exact identity/absence checks.
Native tests for missing roots, exclusive creation, inherited SQLite filenames, bounded reads, retention/sharing, absence changes, hard links and names, junctions, unsafe or changed DACLs.

safety_invariants: Read-only retention always uses FILE_OPEN and a null security descriptor. It never creates, truncates, repairs an ACL, opens SQLite, or exposes a raw writable handle.
Root and child opens retain OBJ_DONT_REPARSE and FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT. Child names follow the existing bounded single-component policy.
Retained regular files use FILE_SHARE_READ only. Retained directories share READ and WRITE but deny DELETE; directory metadata and path identity are revalidated during source capture.

The Windows file/mapping sharing contract is not a proof of currentness or writer authority. Bounded bytes and matching metadata still require an independent complete current-cut witness and the owner's real writer fence. The mapping behavior is documented by Microsoft; an explicit native mapped-file regression has not been run.

Snapshots bind volume serial and 128-bit file ID, creation/write/change times, attributes, allocation/length/link count/kind, and owner/group/security-control/DACL bytes. Delete-pending, reparse objects, and multiple regular-file links are rejected. Read access time is excluded; auditing SACLs are not requested.
Both the retained handle and a fresh anchored filename are compared to the initial snapshot. An absent filename is retained as an observation and must remain absent.

New directory creation first opens and retains the parent read-only, validates its type and local device, then uses parent-handle-relative FILE_CREATE. Unsupported parents are rejected before creating the final component.

New SQLite directories require a protected current-owner-only OI/CI ACL. SQLite file retention permits exactly one owner full-access ACE: either explicit protected/non-inheritable or unprotected/inherited. Foreign principals, null DACLs, additional ACEs and unrecognized flags remain errors.
CreateNew never opens or truncates an existing destination. File and directory flush errors are propagated; no unsupported-filesystem durability success is invented.
Directory metadata is stable only during source capture. Any destination creation must happen after the last source verification; this stage does not hide that deliberate directory mutation.

incorporated: Rename the local SID length variable to sid_length so it does not shadow sid_bytes().
Replace every new expect_err with an explicit Err-matching contextual test helper.
Preflight and retain the parent before creating a new directory; create relative to that parent.

Correct the mapping limitation wording against Microsoft's CreateFileW documentation: sharing does not authenticate currentness or writer authority; do not assert that pre-existing writable mappings bypass share checks.
Add FILE_TRAVERSE only to the new retained-directory mode; preserve every old access-mode mask exactly.

The foreign-principal DACL fixture keeps the valid OI/CI flags so rejection cannot be explained solely by a flag mismatch. The bounded-read fixture also checks metadata-only write drift through an attribute-only handle.

git_diff_check.reason: GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1: a base Cargo.toml blob is absent from the sparse promisor clone. No implicit fetch or Git mutation was performed.
